documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Kalyan Jewellers India Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 10,323 crores and profit after tax of INR 427 crores for Q2 FY27. Management expressed confidence in achieving its growth targets on the back of strong festive demand during Navratri and Dhanteras. The company launched its regional brand ATM in Chennai and plans to open four more ATM showrooms during the current financial year. Additionally, Kalyan Jewellers achieved a non-GML debt-free status and successfully monetized a land parcel as part of its capital allocation strategy. Kalyan Jewellers reported its financial performance for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the company targets minimum revenue growth of 25%.
guidance.quote: And with the store number which is increasing and the stores which we have opened in the last financial year, the revenue growth should be a minimum of 25%, which we have always said that.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a baseline expectation of 10% same-store sales growth.
guidance.quote: No, so we have already always told to keep the number at 10% SSG.

guidance.claim: Management expressed high confidence in beating targeted revenue growth.
guidance.quote: No, we are actually very confident. We are very confident of beating the targeted revenue growth.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain full-year PBT margins at the levels of the previous year on a conservative basis.
guidance.quote: For the full year, we are even on a conservative basis, we hold to the PBT margin of the last financial year.

guidance.claim: Management aims to maintain the share of recycled gold in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.
guidance.quote: For the month of June, the share of recycled gold was in excess of 55%, and our efforts will be to maintain the share in the range of 55% to 60% going forward.

demand_outlook.claim: Q2 demand was robust across most key markets driven by healthy same-store sales growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter on the back of very healthy same-store sales growth across most of the key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The third quarter started strong with encouraging ground growth during Navratri and Dhanteras.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter has started off very well, and we are very encouraged by the growth being witnessed on the ground, especially during Navratri and Dhanteras.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth was visible in Q2 as same-store sales growth exceeded 20% while gold price inflation remained in single digits.
demand_outlook.quote: So if you look at Q2, you are able to see that the volume growth now because Q2, the SSGs are more than 20%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remained robust during most of Q1 FY27, except for one month during Adhik-Maas.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand remained robust during most part of the recently concluded quarter, except for 1 month of. Adhik-Maas.

demand_outlook.claim: Ground-level demand in July remained strong and continued at levels similar to Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand on ground is strong. It continues like Q1.

capex_expansion.claim: Kalyan Jewellers launched its regional brand ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai in August.
capex_expansion.quote: As you are aware, we launched our regional brand, ATM in T. Nagar, Chennai during the month of August.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch four new showrooms for its ATM brand over the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

capex_expansion.claim: Management intends to launch a few flagship stores using internal cash flows.
capex_expansion.quote: There can be a few flagship stores which we have not done over the last two, three years.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is continuing its asset-light expansion strategy.
The company is transitioning into a new era of growth utilizing a franchise model.
capex_expansion.quote: USHERING INTO NEW ERA OF GROWTH WITH FRANCHISE MODEL

capex_expansion.claim: The first Akshaya Thanga Maligai showroom will be launched on August 21st in Chennai, followed by four more showrooms in coming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The first showroom will be launched on 21st August in Chennai and shall be followed by another four showrooms in the next coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to open around 50 Candere showrooms during the financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we told you that Candere we will be opening around 50 showrooms in the financial year.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 consolidated EBITDA reached INR 644 crores compared to INR 497 crores in Q2 of the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Consolidated EBITDA was INR644 crores versus INR497 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects H2 PBT margins to be stable and higher than H1 PBT margins.
margins_costs.quote: So we believe that H2 will be of a better PBT margin than H1 and it will be stable.

margins_costs.claim: Old gold exchange activity is margin dilutive by around 0.2% to 0.3%.
margins_costs.quote: And you know that exchange itself is margin dilutive by around 0.2% -0.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost increases impacted Q1 margins by around 0.2% to 0.3%.
margins_costs.quote: And again, you would have also noticed that there has been employee cost increase, because employees are one of our key strengths, and we always take steps to nurture and retain talent, and that's also there around 0.2% -0.3% in Q1.

margins_costs.claim: The customs duty benefit in Q2 is expected to be in the range of INR 60 crores.
margins_costs.quote: It's in the range of INR60 crores for Q2.

orders_capacity.claim: India business Q2 revenue rose to INR 9,007 crores from INR 6,843 crores in Q2 of the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: For this just concluded quarter, India revenues came in at INR9,007 crores versus INR6,843 crores when compared with the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Middle East Q2 revenue stood at INR 960 crores compared to INR 860 crores in the prior year period.
orders_capacity.quote: Talking about the Middle East business, revenue for the quarter was INR960 crores compared to INR860 crores in the corresponding quarter of the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company cleared its non-GML debt and sold a land parcel for INR 86 to INR 87 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, it is debt-free non-GML now, as you mentioned, and 50% of the collateral is already out of which we have sold one land parcel of INR86 crores, INR87 crores, and INR16 crores to be done on the ongoing quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Cash flows will primarily be deployed to add inventory in existing showrooms to support same-store sales growth.
capital_allocation.quote: But yes, the cash flow, predominantly, we want to utilize to strengthen our existing showrooms where certain showrooms need more inventory to drive more SSGs.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no immediate plans to expand ATM brand showrooms outside Tamil Nadu.
capital_allocation.quote: We will continue only in Tamil Nadu because it has to shape up in one state, and which will at least take a couple of years.

capital_allocation.claim: The company signed agreements to sell two separate land parcels for an aggregate consideration of around INR 102 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We have signed the agreement with potential buyers for 2 separate parcels of land with an aggregate consideration amount to around INR102 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Kalyan Jewellers is on track to complete non-GML debt repayment by end of September.
capital_allocation.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management acknowledged ongoing competitive intensity in the retail jewelry industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: Again, competition intensity is always there in our sector, okay?

risks_headwinds.claim: High gold price volatility leads consumers to temporarily delay store visits.
risks_headwinds.quote: No, people -- I have told you before also, people -- when the gold price volatility is there, people wait when the volatility is very high.

risks_headwinds.claim: A sharp rise in international oil prices led to pressure on foreign exchange during the quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sharp rise in international oil prices and the resultant pressure on forex led us to launch our "Shine with India" gold recirculation campaign.

risks_headwinds.claim: Wedding-related demand slowed down in certain parts of the country during Adhik-Maas.
risks_headwinds.quote: During which wedding-related demand slowed down in certain parts of the country.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to launch four more ATM brand showrooms during the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We have drawn up plans for the launch of the next 4 showrooms over the course of the current financial year, 2 will be in the ongoing quarter and 2 more during the fourth quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to monetize another land parcel worth INR 16 crores in the ongoing quarter.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, it is debt-free non-GML now, as you mentioned, and 50% of the collateral is already out of which we have sold one land parcel of INR86 crores, INR87 crores, and INR16 crores to be done on the ongoing quarter.

management_commitments.claim: The company will restrict ATM brand operations to Tamil Nadu for at least a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue only in Tamil Nadu because it has to shape up in one state, and which will at least take a couple of years.

management_commitments.claim: Kalyan Jewellers is on track to complete non-GML debt repayment by end of September.
management_commitments.quote: Regarding the non-GML debt reduction, we are well on track to complete the repayment by end of September.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to open around 50 Candere showrooms during the financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And we told you that Candere we will be opening around 50 showrooms in the financial year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
